quest.title: End of the Line
quest.description: After rendezvousing with Xiao, you and the others go over the curious and unsettling things you have seen underground...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x1325, Mora x58200, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x11

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *yawn*...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... Where are we...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're still underground.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, are you feeling better?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup, way better! Paimon just got a little fright because she's never seen a crazy place like this before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who would've thought the best guide in all of Teyvat could end up so out of their depth... Hahaha...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah. Heehee...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So anyway, Paimon just had the weirdest dream. There were cattle mooing constantly...

response.speaker: Ushi
response.text: Moo!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, just like that!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw, Ushi, you were looking after Paimon?

response.speaker: Ushi
response.text: Moo, moo.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Traveler, it looks like the Conqueror of Demons is awake.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How do you feel?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...I'm fine. Don't worry.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: The karma I carry is dangerous to humans. Keep your distance.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Well, I have adepti blood in me. So, I wouldn't worry too much.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Even so.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What happened while Paimon was sleeping? How did Xiao get here?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: With a little help, I was able to find my way here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: All thanks to Yanfei.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Conqueror of Demons, could you tell us what happened before you joined us?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: No need to be so formal. Just call me Xiao.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Oh, sure.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: It was a senseless battle.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I came here looking for someone, but when I found them... they weren't anything like how I expected.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Madame Ping says that you usually base yourself at Wangshu Inn to guard the main road through Dihua Marsh. It's unusual for you to go looking for someone yourself... Are they an adeptus?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I'm looking for a yaksha called Bosacius.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (I'm sure I've heard that name somewhere before...)

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Bosacius... Is that one of the Five Yakshas, like you?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I thought that you were the only one left. Aren't the other four... gone from the world?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: You could say that. But Bosacius's body is the only one that was never found.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Yakshas deal with god's remains all the time, and we become tainted by karma. Over time, it inevitably drives us to madness... The last time I saw Bosacius, it was the day he lost his mind.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: He left. No one knew where he went and I never heard from him again.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: But Bosacius was the eldest of us. He once told us, as Yakshas we will experience countless wars. Whether we live or die, we must promise to take care of each other and know each others' fate, to the very end.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Did he forget his promise because he lost his sanity...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: It's possible. But I did not.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I am the sole survivor. So it is my duty to find out the fates of the others.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What made you come to The Chasm? Did you hear something about Bosacius being here?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Did you know that five hundred years ago, the beasts of Khaenri'ah invaded The Chasm?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I've heard a thing or two.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: That war lasted a long time. It is said that in the midst of the battle, a brave yaksha was seen putting up a heroic fight.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: But no one knew the yaksha's name.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: But... there were many more than five yakshas in total, so there's no guarantee it was Bosacius.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... But you must think it was probably him if you came here to investigate, right?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I am by no means certain. And I didn't have any other clues except for this one.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: But Bosacius was proud. If he had taken part in that war, he would have announced his name. So at first... I thought the nameless yaksha couldn't be him.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...You found Bosacius?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Wait, so it was Bosacius you were fighting with? Did he injure you?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Yes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No way...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: The invasion of monsters from Khaenri'ah, the battle in The Chasm, and Yelan's ancestor... I have a feeling that somehow, these are all connected.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Life is full of coincidences, but this is too much of a coincidence. Could this all be related to the Fantastic Compass mentioned in the will, too?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: What will?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Oh, right. I came here because of a will.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Maybe it's not something you've come across much before? But both mortals and adepti sometimes write out their final wishes so somebody else will carry them out after they've passed. It's known as a last will and testament.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: And this... can be done at any time?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, whoa, you wanna write a will now!?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: It was no accident that you saw my illusion that day. This place used your desire to find me to create a trap that you would willingly walk into.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Pure deception is easy to spot, but the truth laced with lies can be a fatal combination. What you heard were really things that I said.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: It made sure you heard my real voice to create panic. This one-way communication was the bait.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: If we hadn't managed to get in touch through the spatial rift, we may well have lost someone by now. Rather than murdering in cold blood, this space seems more intent on consuming souls.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How is this even possible...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Our opponent is very clever. It is not safe to stay here.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Everyone, whether I accomplish what I came here to do or not, I must find a way to get you out safely.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I rejoined to warn you that it's extremely dangerous here. If you stay here too long... this space may well devour you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But how do you know?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What happens if we get "devoured"?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...You might become a shadow of your former self, wandering the underground like a lost soul.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Sounds like you saw them too...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Yelan, you're back.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I've been back a while. I was listening to the conversation.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I've seen some strange things here, too. Objects that shouldn't be here, strange figures appearing then vanishing... I don't think any of it's real.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: So they're just illusions?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: At first, I had the same thought.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: But it's not that simple. There may come a day when these illusions become real and attack you.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: From what you were saying a moment ago, it sounds like you know a way out of here?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I can't say for sure... it's just a guess.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: As Yanfei said, this space is chaotic and unstable, but it has its weaknesses. By attacking the point where both spaces connect, I was able to create a rift and move from one to the other.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: So... If I use all the energy I have, I may be able to tear a passage out of this chaotic space.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Really... So powerful attacks can affect the space itself. I'd wondered if that was a possibility.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Whoa whoa whoa, but what do you mean by all the energy you have?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...I mean, it will take everything I've got.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a minute, when you said you were gonna get us out safely, you mean... you're gonna stay here?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: You can't be serious...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I saw Bosacius underground. That's when I realized the horror of this place.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: A single blast can only create a very small opening. To send you back to the outside world, I may need to continuously channel power in order to keep the tunnel open.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...I know how to fight to the bitter end. I can do this.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But if this takes all the energy you have, you'll...!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: No... No way. Even if what you're saying is true, I can't agree to this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon neither! It's not much of an escape plan if we've gotta leave someone behind!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We should leave together.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: It's only a good or bad plan if there are other options to compare it to. But that's not the situation we're in right now. I doubt you'd still be stuck here if anyone had a better idea.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: But can you be certain that your plan will work?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I cannot.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What is wrong with you? You can't bet your life on something if you don't even know it's gonna work. It's not worth it!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: To conclude, I'm not agreeing to this plan.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: What if I told you... this is my last will?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: You...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: That's your strategy, huh?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: No offense, but we have no guarantee this plan of yours will succeed, or even that it's safe.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: You said it yourself, yakshas pose a danger to humans. You really expect us to accept your self-righteous plan just because you say so?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: The battlefield is a treacherous place. Every opportunity you take, you put everything on the line for. If you fear sacrifice and failure, you can never be victorious.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I've been in my fair share of treacherous battles. So I know full well that you never bring up extreme measures like this until the very, very end.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: You say these things in the hope that we will understand and accept them. But if you don't even know that your self-sacrifice is going to pay off, all you're doing is hurting morale.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Besides, if you were really so determined to end it all, you wouldn't have given us the opportunity to share our opinions. You think you're oh-so cold and ruthless, but I'm not buying it.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: And anyway, losing one of us so the rest can escape? Some victory that is.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Yelan... Don't be so harsh...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Point is, it's not time for drastic measures yet. It's possible there's a hidden passage leading to the exit that we just haven't discovered.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: What if there isn't? Or if we don't find it? And in the end, I'm so weak that I don't have the strength left to sacrifice myself... what do you propose we do then?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: As things stand, there's no difference between sacrificing you and trying to find another way out in terms of the likelihood of success. If we can't say that one strategy is better than the other, we certainly shouldn't be rushing into a risky course of action.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Did someone say a strong enough strike can break us outta this place? Yeah, that's right, I heard ya.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: No one's staying behind to let anyone else out, alright! Enough talk, it's time... for action!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: C'mon, whatever you are, let's see how long you manage to keep us trapped in here after I'm finished with you!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Easy now...

choices.text: (The atmosphere is so tense... What should I do?)
I'll always be with you, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Itto!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Phew... hah... how 'bout that, huh? The path, did ya... see it...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: ...*sigh* Why do you always have to do things like this...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Shinobu...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What happened to Itto? Did he pass out?

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: The boss used up all his strength in one punch. Maybe that's the reason he managed to tear open a passage.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: ...Let me see if there's any way I can stabilize it.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: He did this because he heard us arguing, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: The thing with Boss is, he just can't stand conflict between teammates.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Whenever we get into an argument in the Arataki Gang, he always goes and does something shocking to calm everyone down.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Today, he's done it again. He may not have known you for very long, but when he said he sees everyone as part of the same team, he truly means that.

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Another thing with Boss is, he hates it when other people sacrifice themselves, but he always seems to end up doing it himself... That said, there's a slight distinction to be made with him.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: When he does things like this, he doesn't really think he's sacrificing himself, because he genuinely believes that he's strong enough to defeat any obstacle he's facing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Giant ego alert... And wasn't he just doing the same thing Xiao suggested? So stupid!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why didn't you try to stop him?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: The boss is hardly open to persuasion. Besides, he always acts without thinking. There's no doubt that he really thought he was about to solve everything in one hit.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: It's not just him either. The other guys in the Arataki Gang are more or less the same. That's why they need someone like me to clean up after them.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I couldn't stop him if I tried, so I might as well just let him do his thing. Besides, often his hare-brained intuition is surprisingly on point. We might punch our way out of here yet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... Itto... Please tell Paimon you're okay...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...I'm sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Don't be, you have nothing to apologize for. Both you and Yelan made some very good points.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Still, if this was an Arataki Gang issue and you were one of our members, I have to say I'd side with Yelan on this one.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: The boss definitely wasn't sacrificing himself. He firmly believed that we'd be able to find a way out through the passage he opened up, and he's certainly not expecting to be left behind.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Everyone's important. We have to support each other if we're going to get out of here. Your survival is of huge importance to some people... no, to a whole lot of people.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Shinobu...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Everyone, let's all do our best to try and find a way out. There's still a chance... I'm sure we can escape.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Leave the boss to me. Don't worry.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Everyone, it seems this passage doesn't lead to the outside world, but deeper inside.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What the... so Itto's efforts were in vain...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: No, it's still worth exploring. I'll go and take a look first.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: ...Aha, I see! I'm with you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, what?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: So far, I still haven't found the thing I came looking for. That magical device. Remember?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: If this domain has the power to project our imaginations or the things we're searching for into reality... Well, maybe I can use that to my advantage to track it down.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right! No wonder she keeps telling us to keep going... If it's a magical device, it must be super powerful!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Well, I can't guarantee that, but it's worth a try.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I will find a way.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: #Let them go. But if you were planning on going into that domain too, {NICKNAME}, then come with me.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: After all, I'm just a lawyer, hehe. We'll be safer if we team up.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: By the way, um... You and Xiao seem pretty close, huh? Yelan got a bit worked up just now, so I just wanted to apologize on her behalf.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I have to say, though, if Yelan hadn't spoken out like she did, I'm not sure she would've gotten through to him. Also... self-sacrifice is something Yelan feels strongly about. She'd try to stop whoever it was.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: From what I know, she's lost comrades in the line of duty before, and then was rescued herself. Maybe being a survivor is what makes her so against seeing other people sacrifice themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: How can things ever be the same again, knowing that your life was saved when others weren't? In a way, salvation can also be a burden.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: ...If I were her, I'm not sure if I would have done anything different.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Oh! Wait, one second, I'll be right there.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: ...Hya!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Right, that's much safer. Since Itto can't fight right now, I've cast a spell to protect you guys.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Thank you, Senpai. Please be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: We will, same to you.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Alright, Traveler, let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: What's this?

choices.text: What a weird and wonderful scene...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Look at that huge disc in the distance... Hold on, is that the Fantastic Compass?

choices.text: It's even bigger than a cooking pot...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? That's the best description you can come up with? It's way, way bigger than that!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Huh, well, it seems our theory checked out. In my humble legal opinion, that's almost certainly the magical device I've been looking for. It really showed up...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: But, if this really is the Fantastic Compass... It's so huge! How the heck am I gonna lug that back to my office!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: #...Ahem, I mean, come on Yanfei, don't give up now. Let's investigate the area first, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: What the...! Are they... are they Treasure Hoarders?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What are Treasure Hoarders doing here?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: They look familiar... Oh, yeah, I bumped into these rapscallions a few days ago.

choices.text: It's even bigger than all our heads combined...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Have a taste of this!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Phew, easy peasy. Just like last time.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: You know, when I ran into them before, I was working on a big commercial case. The defendant hired them to attack me, just to get back at me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Being a legal adviser sounds tough...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Eh, happens all the time. Luckily, I'm well trained in martial arts, so taking them down was a piece of cake.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: But these are the exact same guys as I met last time... Is this space recreating scenes from my memory?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Maybe this is one of the ways our adversary intends to devour us... unbelievable.

talks.objective: Find more clues in the space

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I thought we might run into some other people here, but apparently not...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yanfei, what's that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: The Fatui? Whose memory is this?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Aaah, watch out!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hmph, just as I thought.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Yelan, you're here!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I will take you down no matter how many times you show up.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Hey, relax, we're all together now.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Amateurs. And still they dare to come after me.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: You've still got it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That voice just now...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Remember how I said I'd seen some illusions myself?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Those were the same words I heard last time. The space seems to be reproducing that memory...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Now that you know, at least we're all on the same page.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: He said the word "fantastic"... was he talking about the Fantastic Compass?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Yanfei, see that thing on the ground?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Yeah, we tinkered with it, that's how we met up with you. I guess it's a miniature version of the Fantastic Compass in the distance... It has a close connection to the entire space.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hmm. It looks somewhat familiar, let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: ...Another new space.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: If everywhere within this space follows the same rules, there must be another small Fantastic Compass somewhere around here.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...Bosacius, I can't believe someone like you would end up as a lost soul underground.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Xiao!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: No enemies? Hold on...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Wait... is the enemy hiding itself? Oh no, we should go help him—

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Stay back!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: This is my fight... do not come near me.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Ugh! ...*cough*

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Enough... phantom, be gone!
Argh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xiao, are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You haven't even recovered from your injuries yet...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: This is my purpose. Don't worry about me.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: So your invisible opponent was the legendary Bosacius, Marshal Vritras?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: So excuse my stubbornness. Bosacius has been missing for centuries... This may have been the last time I will ever see him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He was saying something about holding the line at all costs...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: He fought here. The nameless yaksha from the legends... it was him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But didn't you say he'd always announce his name? How could his name be lost to time? ...What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I don't know. Maybe he forgot who he was.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Because the karma you spoke of drove him to madness?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Bosacius had already gone mad before he disappeared. There was no way of knowing if his memories were intact.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: He still took part in the battle of The Chasm, despite having gone mad?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: We yakshas are not a race that thrive in peacetime. It's likely that he was drawn by the scent of bloody war.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Slaughter is what we do best... Maybe it's the only thing we know.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: This battle confirmed my suspicions. As we had speculated, this space reflects information from people's minds.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: In other words, despite going mad, Bosacius came here. The illusion we saw just now is the impression he left behind.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: This space recreated him as he was during the battle. The way he fought was so self-destructive... He couldn't possibly have survived.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He fought the monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Bosacius's illusion said he'd discovered the monsters' weakness and lured them underground.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: What kind of place could this be? Defeating Khaenri'ah's monsters is no small feat, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Guys, it could just be me, but... I think I'm suddenly feeling more tired than I was.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: This space is really starting to affect us.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I believe Bosacius stayed here, underground. But now he is gone, and only his illusion remains.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: If we don't leave, we may meet the same fate.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Time to move on.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: You fought well, Bosacius. Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like there's some information here. Shall we take a look?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Okay, let's see.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: It looks like these were letters written by the Millelith soldiers who stayed here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So who's this "Boyang" they mentioned?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Boyang was... one of my ancestors. The one who didn't make it back.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: You mean, Boyang fought alongside Bosacius?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I believe so.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: And the Millelith soldiers were their brothers-in-arms.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: ...I guess now we have a pretty good idea of where everyone that went missing ended up.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhhh... So scary. What happened...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Come on. Let's not stay here.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I have a gut feeling that sooner or later we'll connect all the dots... and then, we'll finally know the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Still, who knows how this space is planning on revealing the answer to us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's nothing here at all!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: What a creepy space.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: It has the feel of the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: But... where are the opponents?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think this is my memory.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your memory? Of what?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of emptiness. That's the power of the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Abyss? So... this place is created purely based on your memory?

choices.text: I'm afraid so. Because I will always remember...
...That the Abyss took my twin away.

talks.objective: Keep up with "the one to find"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *gasp* It's... it's...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #{F#Aether}{M#Lumine}! Wait!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's that shiny round thing on the ground?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (It looks like...)

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: ...The Fantastic Compass?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: In the other spaces, the Fantastic Compass was always partially buried in the ground. But this one is lying flat, intact... as if somebody left it here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh... {F#he}{M#she} was just a figment of your imagination, {NICKNAME}...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #So {F#he}{M#she} appeared as an illusion because you miss {F#him}{M#her} so much, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #I can sense that {F#he}{M#she} is not here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But at least we found this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mmm...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Yanfei, are you sure this is the Fantastic Compass you're looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I think so. There were no pictures in the will, but based on the description, it seems to check out.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Yelan? What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: From the design and build, this Fantastic Compass looks extremely similar to the catalysts used by my clan. I just need to do this, and...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: ...Hmph, someone's used this before. There may be a hidden message inside.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Let's get out of here and find somewhere safer.

talks.objective: Leave the place you are in

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Moo! Moo!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...*panting*...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Whew... 'Kay, so I didn't tear the whole place down

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: But check it out, new path!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: If you need a hero... I'm the man... for the job...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Itto!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...Shoulda seen this coming

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Don't worry. Ushi and I know how to take care of the boss.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I think I can speak for both of us in saying, it's not our first rodeo.

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo, moo!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Go on, get outta here. And be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Bosacius was the leader of the Five Yakshas under Rex Lapis's command. He could control Electro energy.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Unlike me, he was both a formidable warrior and a talented commander.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Now that I've found the Fantastic Compass, my work here is done.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: But if the Bosacius we saw was just an illusion, will we really be able to take anything we find here back to the outside world? Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Alright, here will be fine. Take a moment to catch your breath while I try to unlock the Fantastic Compass.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Within Yin and Yang, among the five regions, water, fire, wind, and thunder cycle like the seasons. Grasp the seven heavens from the ground, open wide the three gates, all the world within reach...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's getting darker...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's that shiny round thing on the ground?.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (It looks like...)
